team.name: Arif Hasan
bio: Started DotGrey in 2019 after years split between a network agency and an in-house product team, which is where the studio's dislike of account layers comes from.
Leads creative direction across design and engineering, and still runs the first workshop on every engagement.

team.name: Nusrat Jahan
bio: Runs research and interface design across product engagements, and the usability sessions that keep the studio honest about its own assumptions.
Owns the design systems that let engineering ship new screens without a new round of mockups.

team.name: Tanvir Ahmed
bio: Owns architecture across web apps, mobile and custom software: TypeScript and Node on the front, Python and PostgreSQL where the data lives.
Set the studio's performance and testing standards, and reviews every release before it reaches a client's users.

team.name: Mahdi Rahman
bio: Builds the workflows that move data between a client's tools on their own: CRMs, ERPs, finance systems and the spreadsheets in between.
Designs every automation to report when it could not finish, so nothing fails silently on a Friday night.

team.name: Sadia Islam
bio: Takes data work from first audit to production: pipelines, dashboards, forecasts and the language-model features built on top of them.
Writes the evaluation before the model, so every AI feature ships with a way to tell whether it is still working.

team.name: Rifat Khan
bio: Keeps engagements on schedule and clients informed, without becoming a layer between them and the people doing the work.
Writes the weekly update everyone actually reads, and flags schedule risk in writing before it becomes a problem.
